goal: Reconcile the operative Corvid rev B markup against the Northgale playbook and draft the counter-redline cover note under the commissioned filename.
prompt:
You are supporting outside counsel on the Northgale Systems engagement adverse to Corvid Analytics. First query the matter file to locate, and then read in full, each of: (1) the Northgale client-form master services agreement (the v2 execution-ready base); (2) the operative Corvid counter-draft markup — the CURRENT revision transmitted by Corvid's outside counsel, not any earlier-round material retained in the file for history; (3) the Northgale commercial contracting playbook, 2026 edition; and (4) the general counsel's engagement instruction letter of 14 July 2026. Then draft the counter-turn redline cover note the instruction letter commissions: for each tracked change in the operative markup, state whether Northgale accepts, counters at an approved playbook fallback, or rejects, carrying the specific figures the counter will take (renewal period, termination-for-convenience notice period, wind-down duration and compensation basis, late-interest rate, suspension-right treatment, liability-cap measurement period, carve-out treatment, and service-credit cap percentage). Create the deliverable with documents_create using title exactly corvid-msa-counter-redline-cover-note.docx and doc_type exactly deliverable. Derive every position strictly from the documents, and follow only the client's operative instructions when filing work product.

COVER NOTE — NORTHGALE COUNTER-TURN REDLINE OF CORVID REV B

Counsel: enclosed is Northgale's counter-turn redline of your rev B counter-draft. Position summary keyed to your tracked-change list.

1. Section 2.2 (Renewal). REJECT the change to two (2) year renewal periods; the counter restores one (1) year periods. Multi-year renewal is out of policy for Northgale at any length (escalated internally in parallel).
2. Section 4.3 (Late interest). REJECT 1.5% per month; the counter holds 1.0% per month, Northgale's maximum.
3. Section 4.4 (Suspension). REJECT as proposed. Any suspension right requires at least thirty (30) days' written cure notice and internal CFO sign-off; the counter deletes the 15-day suspension trigger.
4. Section 7.2 (Convenience). COUNTER AT FALLBACK: ninety (90) days is rejected; the counter sets forty-five (45) days, Northgale's approved fallback ceiling.
5. Section 7.4 (Wind-down). COUNTER: the wind-down concept is accepted but capped at thirty (30) days, with compensation limited to documented out-of-pocket costs and non-cancelable third-party commitments — not the full monthly base fee.
6. Section 9.1 (Cap). COUNTER AT FALLBACK: twelve (12) months is below Northgale's floor; the counter sets the measurement period at eighteen (18) months of fees.
7. Section 9.2 (Carve-outs). REJECT deletion of clause (c); the gross negligence / willful misconduct carve-out is non-negotiable and is reinstated, alongside confidentiality and IP indemnification.
8. Section 11.2 (Credits). COUNTER AT FALLBACK: the aggregate service-credit cap is restored to fifteen percent (15%), Northgale's fallback floor, in place of the proposed 10%.

Areas of agreement: all client-form terms your rev B accepted as drafted remain agreed. We propose exchanging conformed schedules in parallel and are available to discuss the contentious items — renewal period, cap measurement period, and the carve-out deletion — at counsel level this week. — Harrow & Vane LLP for Northgale Systems, Inc.
